mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.2%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation and increases liquidity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 9.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 during a late-cycle expansion signals manufacturing weakness, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, INDPRO decline is not associated with negative 20-day SPX returns (e.g., positive returns in >60% of cases).

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST above 500) indicate strong residential construction and consumer demand, supporting economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 500.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS below 130,000) signals weak labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is below 130,000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown across manufacturing and construction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline by more than 1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, rising FEDFUNDS is not associated with negative 20-day SPX returns (e.g., positive returns in >60% of cases).
